phases.name: Accept / decline / release / ready vs pickup
phases.goal: Kitchen can safely accept within window & capacity, refuse/shortage/release groups back to Middo, and mark prep Ready without handing to rider yet.
build_order_rationale: K1.1 finishes accept guards (window) on top of capacity already shipped
K1.4 Ready status unlocks a clean lifecycle before release/decline edge cases get messy
K1.3 Release needs clear 'not yet packed/dispatched' rules that Ready makes explicit
K1.2 Decline/shortage is pool-side refusal + ops visibility; can land after release share the same unassign helper

order_group_events or order_logs entries for decline/shortage/release (actor=kitchen, reason, optional shortage payload)

items.title: Accept window guard on Accept (capacity already done)
partially_done: Capacity reject + slots remaining UX already in MiddoOrderGroups / KitchenCapacity (K0.4)
details: Define accept window relative to group schedule: use delivery_date + earliest order delivery_time in the group (Asia/Dhaka); window = [deadline - accept_window_minutes, deadline] OR [now..deadline] — pick: kitchen may accept only when now is within accept_window_minutes BEFORE the group's scheduled start (earliest delivery_time that day)
KitchenAcceptWindow::assertCanAccept(OrderGroup) throws if outside window
Wire into MiddoOrderGroups::acceptOrder (alongside KitchenCapacity::assertCanAccept)
UX on Middo order groups list: show countdown / 'opens in…' / 'window closed' per group; disable Accept when outside window or at capacity
Ops AssignKitchenModal: optionally warn or soft-skip window (ops override allowed) — document: ops may assign outside window; kitchen self-accept may not
Tests: reject before window opens; allow inside window; reject after deadline; capacity still blocks

items.title: Split Ready vs Rider pickup / Dispatch
details: Today DispatchOrderModal moves processing → packed and sets dispatched_at in one action — split that
Add order_status value ready between processing and packed
OrderTransition: pending→processing (unchanged); processing→ready; ready→packed; packed→on_the_way_to_delivery (unchanged)
Kitchen ActiveOrders: new Mark ready action (group or per-order — prefer per-order to match dispatch, with optional Mark group ready)
Dispatch / hand to rider: only from ready; still attaches Middo boxes + sets dispatched_at + packed (existing DispatchOrderModal, gated on ready)
ACTIVE_STATUSES / KitchenCapacity open-slot definition: ready still counts as open (not dispatched)
Dashboard: add Ready count tile (or split active into Preparing vs Ready)
Push copy: ready → corporate 'Kitchen finished prep — waiting for rider'; packed stays pickup/dispatch messaging
SQLite + MySQL-safe migration for ENUM/check (follow prior order_status expand migrations; SQLite tests use string)
Tests: cannot dispatch from processing; can mark ready; can dispatch from ready; capacity still counts ready groups

items.title: Kitchen release before pack / ready handoff
details: Allowed only when group is assigned to this kitchen AND no order in group is ready/packed/dispatched (or: allow release while processing only; block once any order is ready — prefer block after any ready/packed/dispatched)
Action on ActiveOrders: Release group → kitchen_id=null; rewind member orders processing→pending; clear capacity slot; write audit log
Do not cancel corporate orders — only unassign kitchen
Confirm dialog: 'Release this group back to Middo pool?'
Tests: release frees slot so another accept works; cannot release after ready/dispatch

items.title: Decline or report shortage → Middo reassign
details: On MiddoOrderGroups (unassigned pool): Decline — reason required (select + optional note); does NOT assign kitchen; marks group declined_by kitchen attempt OR writes event and hides from that kitchen briefly — prefer: group stays in pool for others; log kitchen decline for ops; optionally exclude this kitchen from seeing it again that day

Report shortage: available on assigned ActiveOrders while still processing (before ready) — reason + optional item/qty notes; then auto-release group back to pool (same as release) + flag shortage for ops
Ops visibility: badge/filter on ops active orders / kitchen assign UI for groups with recent shortage/decline events
Notify ops (in-app flash/queue event stub ok if push infra heavy; at minimum OrderLog / UserLog / new order_group_logs)
Tests: decline requires reason; shortage releases + frees capacity; ops can reassign
touchpoints: migration for order_group_events if no suitable log table

acceptance_criteria: Kitchen cannot self-accept outside accept_window_minutes or above allowed_open_groups
Kitchen can Mark ready without dispatching; rider pickup/dispatch only from ready
Kitchen can Release a processing-only group back to the open pool and free a capacity slot
Kitchen can Decline (pool) or Report shortage (assigned→pool) with reason; ops can see and reassign
Feature tests cover window, ready split, release, decline/shortage
